summary: Eleven-day motorhome road trip from Slovenj Gradec to North Holland: Alps, Rhine, Amsterdam, Texel, and a calm return through Heidelberg and Linz.

days.title: Departure from Slovenj Gradec and drive to Salzburg
days.travelHack: Austrian motorways require a vignette; buy it before the border or at the first petrol station.
days.transportationTips: Shorter leg: stop for lunch around Villach or Salzburg, not in the city center.

morning.name: Departure from Slovenj Gradec
morning.description: Prepare the motorhome, check tire pressure, and head north through Carinthia toward Salzburg.

afternoon.name: Stop and lunch on the road
afternoon.description: Stop at a proper rest area or a smaller town along the route — lunch in the motorhome, a short walk, then continue.

evening.name: Arrival at Camping Nord-Sam, Salzburg
evening.description: Set up at Nord-Sam campsite on the outskirts of Salzburg. Park early — August is busy.

days.title: Drive to Koblenz on the Rhine
days.travelHack: Longest leg: out early, 15 min break every 2 hours.
days.transportationTips: German autobahns have no tolls, but traffic builds around major cities. Use live navigation.

morning.name: Departure from Salzburg toward Koblenz
morning.description: Early departure from Salzburg and a long drive toward Koblenz — most of the day on German autobahns.

afternoon.name: Stop for lunch and a break
afternoon.description: A long drive needs regular stops. Pull over in a smaller town along the route or at a proper rest area for lunch in the motorhome.

evening.name: Arrival at Campingpark Winningen near Koblenz
evening.description: Set up at Winningen campsite on the Moselle, near Koblenz — quiet surroundings after a long leg.

days.title: Drive to Amsterdam and explore the area
days.travelHack: Into Amsterdam with a motorhome only via P+R / edge campsite — not the center.
days.transportationTips: From Zeeburg campsite to the center by tram or bus. Watch for cyclists.

morning.name: Departure from Koblenz toward Amsterdam
morning.description: Morning drive from Germany into the Netherlands — shorter leg than yesterday, with more time to reach the campsite.

afternoon.name: Arrival at Camping Zeeburg Amsterdam
afternoon.description: Set up at Zeeburg campsite — a good base for Amsterdam, connected by public transport.

evening.name: Walk along Lake IJmeer
evening.description: After the drive, walk to nearby IJmeer — calm nature and birdwatching.

days.title: Sightseeing in Amsterdam and canal cruise
days.travelHack: Buy Anne Frank House tickets online — daily quotas fill quickly.
days.transportationTips: Tram 26 from Zeeburg to Centraal. Leave the motorhome at the campsite.

morning.name: Anne Frank House
morning.description: Visit the Anne Frank House — moving and informative; advance booking is required.

afternoon.name: Amsterdam canal boat cruise
afternoon.description: Experience Amsterdam from the water: canal houses, bridges, and lively city life.

evening.name: Evening at Zeeburg campsite
evening.description: After returning to Zeeburg campsite, enjoy a relaxed evening — dinner in the motorhome or a walk around the area.

days.title: Day trip to Zaanse Schans and Volendam
days.travelHack: Zaanse Schans is touristy — arrive early, before the bus groups.
days.transportationTips: Short day with the motorhome: RV parking is marked; in Volendam park outside the pedestrian zone.

morning.name: Visit Zaanse Schans
morning.description: Idyllic village with windmills, cheese farms, and traditional wooden houses.

afternoon.name: Volendam on the IJsselmeer
afternoon.description: Fishing town with a waterfront and lake views — short walk and coffee by the water.

evening.name: Return to Zeeburg campsite
evening.description: Back to the campsite before evening traffic; prepare dinner in the motorhome.

days.title: Texel island — nature and beaches
days.travelHack: Leave the motorhome in Den Helder; to the island as a pedestrian + bike — cheaper and easier.
days.transportationTips: Den Helder–Texel ferry takes approximately 20 minutes. Paid parking at the terminal.

morning.name: Drive to Den Helder ferry terminal
morning.description: Early departure from the campsite and drive to the ferry terminal in Den Helder, where you sail to Texel.

morning.name: Ferry to Texel island
morning.description: Short ferry ride across the Wadden Sea (UNESCO). Enjoy the sea views.

afternoon.name: Explore Texel by bike
afternoon.description: Rent bikes and explore beaches, dunes, and villages. Must-see: Duinen van Texel and Eierland lighthouse.
bullets: Visit Duinen van Texel nature reserve.
Eierland lighthouse on the north of the island.

evening.name: Evening at Zeeburg campsite Amsterdam
evening.description: After the ferry return and drive back to Zeeburg campsite — relaxed evening and dinner in the motorhome.

days.title: Dune walk and visit to Haarlem
days.travelHack: Last full night in the Netherlands — check water and waste tanks before tomorrow's departure.
days.transportationTips: Zuid-Kennemerland National Park has visitor parking; Haarlem center is best on foot.

morning.name: Zuid-Kennemerland National Park
morning.description: Walk through dunes west of Amsterdam — open coastal nature close to the city.

afternoon.name: Explore Haarlem
afternoon.description: Historic center, Grote Markt, and St. Bavo Cathedral — relaxed afternoon visit.

evening.name: Zeeburg campsite Amsterdam
evening.description: Last night in the Netherlands — quiet evening at the campsite before heading south.

days.title: Start the return journey to Heidelberg
days.travelHack: Book the Heidelberg campsite in advance — August is busy.
days.transportationTips: Long leg south: plan two longer breaks and refuel before evening traffic.

morning.name: Departure from Amsterdam
morning.description: Say goodbye to the Netherlands in the morning and start the return journey — first stop is Heidelberg.

afternoon.name: Stop on the road in Germany
afternoon.description: Lunch at a rest area or in a smaller town along the route; stretch and a short walk before continuing.

evening.name: Arrival at Heidelberg campsite
evening.description: Set up at a campsite near Heidelberg — evening for rest after the drive.

days.title: Drive to Linz in Austria
days.travelHack: On entering Austria, check that your vignette is still valid.
days.transportationTips: Heidelberg–Linz leg: expect several hours on the motorway and possible delays around Munich.

morning.name: Departure from Heidelberg
morning.description: Continue the return journey toward Linz — longer drive through southern Germany into Austria.

afternoon.name: Stop for lunch
afternoon.description: Stop at a rest area or in a smaller town — lunch in the motorhome and a short break.

evening.name: Campsite near Linz
evening.description: Set up at a campsite near Linz — prepare for tomorrow's crossing into Slovenia.

days.title: Last long leg: to Ptuj
days.travelHack: Ptuj is a calm last stop before home — top up supplies in Austria if anything is running low.
days.transportationTips: Crossing into Slovenia is quick; choose a campsite with waste disposal before the final day.

morning.name: Departure from Linz toward Ptuj
morning.description: Last long leg: from Austria into Slovenia to Ptuj.

afternoon.name: Walk through old Ptuj
afternoon.description: Short walk through Ptuj's streets and castle — easy end to a driving day.

evening.name: Campsite near Ptuj
evening.description: Last night on the road — quiet evening before the short drive home.

days.title: Arrival home in Slovenj Gradec
days.travelHack: Before returning home, empty the waste tank and fill water if you're going straight to storage/garage.
days.transportationTips: Short local leg — no motorway stress.

morning.name: Departure from Ptuj to Slovenj Gradec
morning.description: After breakfast, short drive home to Slovenj Gradec — end of the motorhome trip.

afternoon.name: Arrival home and unpacking
afternoon.description: Park, unpack, and run through the post-trip checklist (gas, water, waste tank).
